objective: 继续优化 Kimi K3 prefill 的 chunk_kda kernel，在当前 9ac2710bd 基线和 TP8/GB300 workload 上寻找可证明的端到端收益；保持 chunk_kda ABI、状态写回、gate 语义和精度不变，候选必须经过独立正确性、精度、配对性能和必要的 NCU/NSYS 证据。

source.availability: verify locally before use; see source-trace.md

rules: Validation command passes with zero failures and a non-zero case count.
Performance evidence is recorded with the exact source commit and workload definition.
A rejected candidate records the reason instead of being silently discarded.
Every candidate uses the immutable baseline with repeated interleaved paired trials; smoke runs cannot satisfy acceptance.
The final candidate has an independent Claude or human review over the frozen evidence bundle.

next_actions: Use the NCU H-stage evidence to design one structural candidate, or leave the base unchanged if no contract-safe transformation is identified.
Do not promote a parameter-only result without two independent full paired runs.
Serving validation remains not performed until an operator candidate passes the workload gates.
